High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Endor: Ewok Village (V)]] (Virtual Set 8, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 8/Light/Endor Ewok Village.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/15Alam0wOVcL7MO7n-kmObwSXMijy7-Vg/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Endor Ewok Village.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,460 bytes, SHA-256 <code>7fe8226da1302486e0e9839818db0404c4a8dea64f998f607698b36f0a12b90e</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face remains the exact historical [[:File:V8-L-endorewokvillage-2018-07-08.gif|PC source image]]. This third-party print-ready copy is retained as a credited fan-project comparison. Its frame/copyright layout and host-label treatment differ from that official face, so it is not identified as a same-image High-Res Scan or an additional official PC version. Existing image bytes and the original TIFF master remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
